title: Segregated solutions of a degenerate cross-diffusion system with drifts
summary: We prove the global existence of segregated weak solutions of a one-dimensional degenerate cross-diffusion system with independent drifts, which is endowed with a Wasserstein gradient flow structure. We argue by a Lagrangian formulation written in terms of the (pseudo-)inverse for the cumulative mass function of the sum of the species, which we solve by a Minimising Movement Scheme in the setting of $L^2 \cap BV_{\mathrm{loc}}$. This Lagrangian problem gives rise to a parabolic PDE similar to a $p$-Laplace equation, with typical range $p \in (-\infty,1)$. We employ monotonicity methods…
